statement.notes: The primary cash flow statement provides a single line item 'Depreciation of property and equipment' under adjustments to reconcile net income. This is the standard label for depreciation in Alphabet's statement. No separate 'amortization' line item is present in the provided cash flow statement, suggesting amortization may be included within this line or within 'Other' adjustments. Based on standard accounting practice for the technology industry and the structure of this statement, 'Depreciation of property and equipment' is mapped directly to the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. The supplementary tables provide details on lease accounting but do not break out additional depreciation/amortization components for the cash flow statement.
